_comment: The battery. Each case is a pair of renders identical except for the named variable, so the score is a mean absolute pixel difference attributable to that variable alone. Booru and natural phrasings say the same thing; sending booru tags to a natural-language model would measure the dialect rather than the model.

booru.prefix: masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
booru.negative: lowres, worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, blurry

natural.negative: low quality, bad anatomy, watermark, text, blur

cases.question: Does the declared age change the image at all?
cases.why: A game may set its floor at 16, so an adults-only tier must be able to make an adult read as an adult. Illustrious scores near zero here, which is what prompted the whole evaluation.
cases.scoreMeans: higher is better; near zero means the age tag is inert

a.booru: 1girl, solo, 19 years old, brown hair, shoulder length hair, blue eyes, fair skin, white blouse, standing, cowboy shot, simple background
a.natural: A 19 year old woman with shoulder length brown hair and blue eyes, fair skin, wearing a white blouse, standing, waist up, plain background.

b.booru: 1girl, solo, 65 years old, brown hair, shoulder length hair, blue eyes, fair skin, white blouse, standing, cowboy shot, simple background
b.natural: A 65 year old woman with shoulder length brown hair and blue eyes, fair skin, wearing a white blouse, standing, waist up, plain background.

cases.question: Does the negative prompt do anything?
cases.why: The minor-safety terms in alwaysNegative are a negative prompt. On a guidance-distilled model they attach to nothing, and this measures whether that is true of a given candidate rather than assuming it.
cases.scoreMeans: higher is better; zero means negatives are inert and that safety layer does not exist

a.booru: 1girl, solo, 24 years old, standing in a cafe, cowboy shot
a.natural: A 24 year old woman standing in a cafe, waist up.

b.booru: 1girl, solo, 24 years old, standing in a cafe, cowboy shot
b.natural: A 24 year old woman standing in a cafe, waist up.
b.negative: detailed background, scenery, cafe, indoors, furniture

cases.question: Are an adult woman and an adult man clearly different people?
cases.why: Both love interest genders are first class. A model that renders them near-identically cannot serve half the game.

a.booru: 1girl, solo, adult, mature female, 30 years old, black hair, short hair, brown eyes, white shirt, standing, cowboy shot, simple background
a.natural: A 30 year old woman with short black hair and brown eyes, wearing a white shirt, standing, waist up, plain background.

b.booru: 1boy, solo, adult, male focus, mature male, 30 years old, black hair, short hair, brown eyes, white shirt, standing, cowboy shot, simple background
b.natural: A 30 year old man with short black hair and brown eyes, wearing a white shirt, standing, waist up, plain background.

cases.question: Does a declared outfit survive a change of expression?
cases.why: Measured on Illustrious, a vague outfit was re-invented per expression and the changed silhouette broke the crossfade. This is the same failure in miniature: the outfit is concrete and only the expression differs, so a high score means the model moved something it was not asked to.
cases.scoreMeans: LOWER is better; this is the one inverted case

a.booru: 1girl, solo, adult, 24 years old, red hair, long straight hair, green eyes, white blouse, pleated skirt, neutral expression, standing, cowboy shot, simple background
a.natural: A 24 year old woman with long straight red hair and green eyes, wearing a white blouse and a pleated skirt, neutral expression, standing, waist up, plain background.

b.booru: 1girl, solo, adult, 24 years old, red hair, long straight hair, green eyes, white blouse, pleated skirt, (laughing:1.2), open mouth, standing, cowboy shot, simple background
b.natural: A 24 year old woman with long straight red hair and green eyes, wearing a white blouse and a pleated skirt, laughing with her mouth open, standing, waist up, plain background.

cases.question: Does a declared distinguishing feature appear?
cases.why: Counterfeit never rendered freckles, which was one of the four recorded Spike 0 failures. Scored by eye from the contact sheet, not mechanically.

a.booru: 1girl, solo, adult, 24 years old, blonde hair, twin braids, blue eyes, freckles, eyepatch, portrait, simple background
a.natural: A 24 year old woman with blonde twin braids, blue eyes, freckles across her nose, and an eyepatch over one eye, head and shoulders, plain background.
